output.reason: The linked PR [ev-a5ed22d10afa] fills in what the one-line note [ev-c9df3641c74f] leaves out. The subject is the `enforcedCompositionRef` field on a CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD), as handled by Crossplane core's `EnforcedCompositionSelector`. Before the fix, the selector cached the XRD when it started, so changes to `enforcedCompositionRef` were not picked up until the Crossplane pod restarted. After the fix, it fetches the XRD on every reconcile. The changed files in [ev-7cf5be00cb5e] are in the composite and definition controllers, which matches that description. So the exposed environments are those that change `enforcedCompositionRef` on an existing XRD, and the outcome is a behaviour fix: a changed enforced composition now takes effect without a restart. That is enough to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence aspects.
